title: Lobby display
description: A link for a TV in the lobby or a tablet on the dock: today's boats, who is aboard as a count, and where to meet. No sign-in on that screen.

create.heading: New screen
create.purposeCheckInDescription: A check-in tablet records that a diver has arrived. It never puts anyone on a boat: the crew still does roll call at the rail.
create.showNamesDescription: Anyone in the room reads them. Only the crew who agreed to be named appear, and divers never do.

newLink.heading: Open this on the screen
newLink.shownOnce: Copy it now, because it is shown once. If you lose it, revoke this screen and create another.
newLink.shared: Anyone with this link sees today's departures without signing in. Treat it like a key to the shop.
newLink.sharedCheckIn: Anyone with this link can mark a diver as arrived without signing in. Treat it like a key to the shop.

list.heading: Screens
list.confirmRevoke: Revoke this link? The screen goes dark on its next refresh.

notice.denied: Only an owner or manager can change lobby screens.
notice.invalidLabel: Give the screen a name of up to {max, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.

boatLine.heading: Where each boat is in its day
boatLine.detail: On the storefront, and on the link a diver shares. A stage word and a time, never who is aboard.
boatLine.label: Say where each boat is in its day

year.heading: Our year on DiveDay's pages
year.description: The year card, no money on it.
year.label: Show our year on DiveDay's pages
year.detail: Divers, boats out, sites, your busiest day and the strip of days. Never money, never a diver's name.
year.noticeOn: Your year is on DiveDay's pages.
year.noticeOff: Your year is off DiveDay's pages.
